blocks.text: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala turned heads once again as she made her Paris Fashion Week debut at luxury fashion house Chanel’s show. Alex — who donned a tweed jacket paired with relaxed pants — graced the event alongside her mother, Rizza, as seen in the photos shared by the athlete on her Instagram page on Tuesday, Oct. 6. “Freedom, made tangible. A beautiful collision of heritage, movement and artistry,” she captioned her post. During the show, the mother and daughter also met Singaporean actress Tan Kheng Hua and her daughter Shi-An Lim.
